product_metadata.title: Moss & Stone Electric Coffee Percolator | Body with Stainless Steel Lids Coffee Maker | Percolator Electric Pot - 10 Cups Camping Coffee Pot (Purple)
features: PREMIUM QUALITY COFFEE PERCOLATOR - Classic electric percolator brews from 2 to 10 cups of great-tasting coffee, hot, rich, and flavorful, for you to enjoy your day.

PERFECT COFFEE ACCESSORY- Our Electric 10 cup percolator comes with a removable coffee filter, including a filter basket and pump tube, easy pour spout, and traditional design to provide elegant coffe anytime without a spill.

STYLISH DESIGN - A substantial perculator style coffee pots made of a durable purple stainless steel body with a cool black touch handle, ready-to-serve indicator light, and automatic keep-warm function to keep the coffee hot, just like the old-style coffee makers.
COFFEE POT DIMENSION - The electric coffeemaker percolator has a size of 28cm (H) X 23cm (L) X 14.5cm (W)

CUSTOMER SUPPORT - We at Moss & Stone offer top-quality electric coffee percolators and a 1-Year warranty with top-of-the-line customer service, which you won't get with other brands that sell perculator coffee pots!!
